1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2.strategy: Completes the fianchetto and prepares castling. The c4-pawn already challenges d5, and once the f3-knight moves the bishop adds to that pressure down the long diagonal. White plays for slow, lasting pressure on Black's centre and queenside.

1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 Be7.strategy: Solid and flexible: Black prepares to castle and keeps d5 firmly held. There is no commitment in the centre; Black waits for White to show a plan and accepts that White keeps a slightly freer game.

1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 c5.strategy: Strikes at the centre at once instead of supporting d5 with a pawn. With the knight already on f6 Black can recapture on d5 either way after cxd5, which gives an open, active game in which the central pawns need looking after.

1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 dxc4.strategy: Takes the pawn and frees d5, so the g2-bishop will get the whole long diagonal once the knight moves. White can regain the pawn soon, among other ways with the check Qa4+, so Black gets only a short-lived extra pawn and must complete development with care.
1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 dxc4.name: English Opening: Agincourt Defence, Catalan Defence Accepted

1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 c6.strategy: Supports d5 with a pawn and keeps the option of taking on c4 or holding the centre. Development is slower, as the c8-bishop is shut in behind e6, but the pawn structure is hard to break down.

1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 b6.strategy: Mirrors White's fianchetto, but d5 is already under pressure from the c4-pawn and the bishop on b7 would be shut in behind that pawn. Playable, though Black gets less from it than from the more usual ways of supporting the centre.

1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 Bd6.strategy: An offbeat alternative to the usual bishop development: it aims at the kingside and supports a later ...e5, but it is less flexible than the retreat to e7 and blocks the d-file, so Black has fewer ways to react to White's pressure on the centre.
1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 Bd6.name: English Opening: Agincourt Defence, Bogoljubow Defence
